name: Desktop app
summary: The agent ships as a native or Electron-style desktop application, which can reach local files, local MCP servers and other apps on the machine while offering a richer interface than a terminal. Claude Desktop, for example, hosts local MCP servers and renders MCP Apps.
how: Package the agent UI as a desktop app
Connect local tools such as files or MCP servers over stdio
Ask the user before sensitive local actions
facts: Local access and rich UI, but per-OS builds and updates
goodFor: Agents that work with local files and apps
Users who want an always-available assistant
watchOut: Code signing and updates for each OS
Broad local access raises security stakes
